about_the_game:
Fly & Shadow is a 2D action-adventure platformer set in the world of Drury

You play as a lone figure caught between two forces: himself and his shadow. Is he chasing it… or is it chasing him?

Every run is a test of speed, instinct, and focus. The levels are procedurally generated, ensuring no two runs ever play the same. Gather collectibles and coins, race for high scores, and uncover fragments of Drury’s hidden past along the way.

Key Features

  • Run, Jump, and Glide: Fast, responsive movement built for smooth flow and momentum.

  • Procedurally Generated Levels: Every run offers a new challenge and layout.

  • Collect and Compete: Gather coins, expand your collection, and aim for record-breaking runs.

  • Atmospheric Pixel Art: A vibrant, hand-crafted visual style that captures the rhythm and mystery of Drury.

  • Evolving Lore: Meet new characters and stories across future games, media, and content expanding the world of Drury.

name: Fly and Shadow

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 260X or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound device
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on most modern PCs and laptops.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound device
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p gameplay

short_description: A fast-paced 2D action adventure set in the mysterious world of Drury. Run, jump, and soar through procedurally generated levels as you chase, or are chased by your own shadow. Collect coins, grow your collection, and race to the top of the leaderboard!
